section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.question: Slots 02, 03 and 04 progressed the full deterministic offline pipeline to M5; Slot 05 terminated at M2_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Why?
section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.same_pipeline_same_thresholds: All four ran the identical deployed image (sha256:34e5974f...), the identical phase1-m1@2 crawl policy (25 pages / 48 HTTP / 18 MB / 300 s / depth 3), the identical unchanged deterministic offline M2 economic model, and the identical M2 sufficiency threshold. Nothing in code or configuration differed between slots. The divergence is entirely in the first-party public evidence each site yielded.

the_determinant_is_evidence_composition_.observation: Slot 05 returned the LARGEST evidence set of the batch (179 rows, vs 161 / 20 / 115) and tied for the most pages (17), yet it is the one that failed M2. Raw volume is not what M2 scores.

slot_2_webbair.reading: balanced - deep service catalogue PLUS strong conversion-pathway evidence PLUS geographic/service-area specificity

slot_3_bncair.reading: tiny site (3 pages) but the HIGHEST inbound-path density of the batch - a clear, concentrated conversion-pathway signal was enough for M2

slot_4_allelements.reading: service-depth dominant plus company/about evidence; partial crawl (13/20 pages) but the service-description mass carried M2

slot_5_fintastic.reading: nearly half the evidence is low-value public_other; service-description is a minority; inbound-path evidence is proportionally the WEAKEST of all four (5% vs 18-25%); almost no company or geographic specificity

conversion_pathway_evidence_absolute_cou.note: Slot 5's 9 inbound-path rows are spread across 17 pages (0.5/page) vs Slot 3's 5 across 3 pages (1.7/page) and Slot 2's 29 across 24 pages (1.2/page)

section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.corroborating_signal: Slot 05's site was extraordinarily phone-CTA-dense - the minimizer stripped 11,948 phone occurrences (vs 16-290 for the others). That is consistent with a site built around a repeated call-now CTA across templated pages rather than substantive, differentiated service and company description. After minimization removed the contact CTAs, what remained for M2 was proportionally thin on the structured signal (service depth + conversion pathway + specificity) that the economic model needs.
section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.mechanism: M2 (deterministic, offline) attempts to assemble a SCORED addressable opportunity from the M1 public FACTs. It requires a coherent minimum of (a) substantive service-offering description, (b) inbound / conversion-pathway evidence, and ideally (c) company or service-area specificity. Slots 02-04 each cleared that bar by a different strength - 02 by balance + geography, 03 by concentrated inbound-path density, 04 by service-description mass + company evidence. Slot 05's evidence was high-volume but low-structure: dominated by unclassified public_other, minority service-description, and the weakest proportional conversion-pathway evidence, with negligible company/geographic specificity. The model could not build a scored opportunity above threshold and returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.truth_taxonomy_note: The fact_class distributions, page counts, evidence counts and removed-contact counts above are FACTs (stored diagnostic rows). The causal explanation linking Slot 05's evidence composition to the M2 verdict is INFERENCE from those FACTs plus the known M2 model design; it asserts nothing about Slot 05's actual internal business (lead volume, response time, revenue, staffing) - public thinness is not internal thinness.
section_13_comparative_analysis_why_02_0.this_is_the_control_working: M2_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is a truthful, owner-pre-accepted negative company outcome. It was sealed as-is: no redraw, no replacement, no threshold reduction, no evidence fabrication, no repair.
